description: Sub-workflow: sends one Lark message per input item ({text} or {card} JSON 2.0, optional reply_to) as the Lark content bot. With reply_to it replies in that message's thread; otherwise it posts to the team group (settings lark_chat_id) or, before a group is linked, to the owner's direct chat (lark_open_id). Returns {message_id, delivered, note} per item.
name: Content agent: lark send

parameters.jsCode: return $('Build messages').first().json.messages.map((m) => ({ json: { message_id: null, delivered: false, note: m.note || '' } }));
